description: This file defines the 'Allergen' class, an embeddable component representing an allergen entity within the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes properties for allergen type, coded allergen concept, and non-coded allergen description, along with methods for managing and comparing allergen instances.

classes.name: Allergen
classes.description: Embeddable class representing an allergen with type, coded concept, and non-coded string.

methods.name: Allergen
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty Allergen instance.

methods.name: Allergen
methods.description: Constructor initializing Allergen with specified type, coded concept, and non-coded allergen string.

methods.name: getCodedAllergen
methods.description: Returns the coded Concept representing the allergen.

methods.name: setCodedAllergen
methods.description: Sets the coded Concept for the allergen and clears non-coded allergen if necessary.

methods.name: setNonCodedAllergen
methods.description: Sets the non-coded allergen string and clears coded concept if necessary.

methods.name: isCoded
methods.description: Checks if the allergen is coded.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the allergen as a string, prioritizing non-coded if available.

methods.name: isSameAllergen
methods.description: Compares this allergen with another for equality based on coded or non-coded value.

methods.name: setOtherNonCodedConceptUuid
methods.description: Sets the UUID that represents the 'other non-coded' concept.

methods.name: getOtherNonCodedConceptUuid
methods.description: Retrieves the UUID corresponding to the 'other non-coded' concept.
